item.title: Review: Brewers beat the Rays to win the first World Series title in franchise history
item.description: The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers playing in the smallest market in the majors are World Series champions for the first time. The championship comes in the 58th season for a franchise that began as the Seattle Pilots in 1969.
